prompt: A custom resource generation advances but status never catches up. Diagnose safely.
directAnswer: Bind cluster, CRD and object UID, generation, controller image/leader, queue and RBAC. Stale observedGeneration localizes the failure to watch, queue, reconcile, dependency or status-write paths. Preserve the first error, repair the smallest source problem, then verify current status, owned children, external state and user operation.
foundation: Status is a controller report tied to an observed desired generation.
seniorAnswer: I never call stale Ready status healthy; I bind it to generation and re-observe the actual dependency.
whyWeak: Restarting loses evidence and does not fix RBAC, identity, idempotency or dependencies.

followUps.answer: Watches and retries can repeat work.
Names can be reused; UID binds lifetime.
